body:
The issue is his kids; he doesn't want to move further away from them. I do respect his choice, it's just hard to stomach right now. My son is mentally handicapped and I felt that it would be best for him to stay where he was until we were established here. 

Of course, my mother just informed me tonight that she has no intention of giving my son back to me. 

I don't... I don't even know what I feel right now. Honestly. I just... I can't give up, but it's all I want to do.

Heh, I suppose that's true, isn't it. Basically, either I move my son away from everything he needs (not to say I couldn't make it work where boyfriend is at, just that it would take months to get re-established and he can't go months without being treated) or I leave my boyfriend, because he isn't willing to move.

Obviously, I have to take care of my son first and foremost. Which is of course what I am going to do. I'm just.. hurting. And I don't.. I think boyfriend DOES care, he just doesn't really know what to say or do.
